function: Serves static content with nginx. It has no management interface, no user accounts, and hosts no application runtime.

applicability.basis: 27 of the 137 rules in V4R5 govern a management interface, hosted applications, or user accounts and identities, and this image has none of those. The rest state logging, TLS, and session requirements that the Web Server SRG states in terms that fit an HTTP server.
The image's function is serving and proxying HTTP, which is the subject of the Web Server SRG.

deviations.reason: No drift job yet reports newer inputs; the lock is refreshed only by running acquire.py --refresh by hand.
deviations.compensating: A refreshed lock is still a reviewed pull request; nothing edits it automatically.

deviations.reason: The base's age against the publisher's current release is not yet measured by any job.
deviations.compensating: The base is refreshed by hand with acquire.py --refresh, and the lock records the date.

deviations.reason: No release workflow yet generates or attests a bill of materials.
deviations.compensating: The embedded package inventory records every installed package and is checked against the lock.

deviations.reason: No release workflow yet signs the image or attests its provenance.
deviations.compensating: The image is built only in CI from a reviewed commit, and its labels name the commit and lock.

deviations.reason: Nothing is published yet, so there are no tags to protect.
No vulnerability scan yet gates the build.
deviations.compensating: The inputs are the current UBI 9 releases, refreshed by hand.

deviations.reason: No malware scan yet runs on the inputs or the image.
deviations.compensating: Every input is verified by digest and Red Hat signature.

deviations.reason: The image has not yet been deployed under the Restricted Pod Security Standard or OpenShift's restricted-v2 SCC.
deviations.compensating: The smoke suite runs it with every capability dropped, no new privileges, the default seccomp profile, and an arbitrary UID, which is what both profiles require.

deviations.reason: This repository's default branch is not yet protected, which is Package 6 of the roadmap.
deviations.compensating: Changes arrive by pull request with CI; none is pushed directly by convention.

deviations.reason: No secret, static-analysis, or dependency scan yet runs before the build.
deviations.compensating: The image contains no code of its own, only configuration and verified RPMs.

deviations.reason: nginx does not refuse a group- or world-readable key file, which the criterion requires. It does refuse a missing or empty one.
deviations.compensating: The key is mounted read-only and never reaches arguments, environment, or logs; the platform mounts it with restrictive permissions (PLT-06).
